clues.title: Plate: Colombia
text: Colombian licence plates are typically yellow.
NOTE: Within South America, yellow licence plates are almost exclusively found in Colombia.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Coverage: Coverage Meta - Arauca Rift
text: On the road in Arauca and in the city of Arauca in northeastern Colombia, there is virtually only cloudy, bad weather coverage. Furthermore, there was a small camera glitch where you can see this small rift northeast of the driving direction.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Landscape - Pasto Hills
text: In southern Colombia, around the city of Pasto, there are hilly fields that are unique in that they are bordered by hedges. The hedges are very thick and form very distinctive lines on the hills. It almost gives off a “British” vibe. If you are sure that it is Colombia, this is a very good meta, but such fields with hedges also occur in Ecuador.
!! In very rare cases, such hedges on hills can also occur in other parts of Colombia. !!

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Agriculture - Banana - Hedge
text: In Quindio you will commonly find banana plantations behind hedges.

clues.title: Agriculture - Banana - Small Field / No Hedge
text: In the states surrounding Quindio you will find smaller banana plantations along the road not behind hedges.

clues.title: Google car: Agriculture - Banana - Cloudy Gen 3
text: Large amounts of banana plants in plantations are commonly found in different areas.
Paired with Cloudy Gen 3 Coverage, they're most common in Northwestern Antioquia.

clues.title: Landscape: Agriculture - Banana - Dry
text: In Magdalena you will often see banana plantations in a dry sandy/dirty area with mountains to your east.

clues.title: Vegetation: Vegetation - Veracruz Trees
text: In Colombia you will most commonly find these trees that appear to have a knot on top of their trunk in the dark red areas. The province of Cordoba has the most gen 4 out of the others so if you see these in gen 4 consider Cordoba. (If the area is flat/semi hilly, You can find these trees in the mountains aswell everywhere)

clues.title: Pole: Infrastructure - Sarawak Pole
text: Asymmetrical poles with a "Sarawak" extension (a vertical stalk coming out the top), can **often** be found East of Andes. Note that this pole is not 100%, and has been spotted elsewhere.
